npcs.name: Triệu Khách
npcs.wants_to_say: He is done fighting alone and wants a team he can trust.

npcs.name: Vương Đông Lượng
npcs.wants_to_say: He leads a four-person group with Hắc Khổng Tước and a dwarf, and will bargain stamps to keep his life.

npcs.name: Carrie
npcs.wants_to_say: She survives on Đại Hạ aboard the crashed Noah and needs rescue; she can trigger a wormhole home.

npcs.name: Hồng bà bà
npcs.wants_to_say: She is the sixteenth master of the Ghost Market and holds the tịch diệt seat among the ten peak postmen.
npcs.wants_to_hide: Her real goal is to end the whole postman system, herself included.

npcs.name: Heo mập
npcs.wants_to_say: He can fire Đọa ma pháo and knows the Ghost Market lies between the horror space and reality.

npcs.name: Ải Cước Hổ
npcs.wants_to_say: He is a mid-rank postman who thinks only of running when a stronger foe like Huyền Xuyên shows up.

npcs.name: Tề Lượng
npcs.wants_to_say: He stands second on the Huyền Thưởng Bảng and leads a team with healing holy light, protecting his men.

npcs.name: Âm Dương lão nhân
aliases: the keeper of Khách sạn Âm Dương
npcs.wants_to_say: He keeps the Yin-Yang Inn, the only way home, and represents space among the ten peak postmen.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He hears the gods calling him and is slowly being assimilated.

npcs.name: Vương Ma Tử
npcs.wants_to_say: He lives in the abandoned land among crippled postmen and leads a second team under Triệu Khách.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He is Ngô Cửu, who destroyed his own life stamp to hide from an enemy.

npcs.name: Dương Vạn Tài
npcs.wants_to_say: He is the richest man in the Ghost Market, runs the chamber of commerce and betting, and copies medicine buns.
npcs.wants_to_hide: His real name is Dương Đông.

npcs.name: Cơ Vô Tuế
aliases: corpse woman in the red coffin
npcs.wants_to_say: She will say little, but she has given Triệu Khách the Tạo hóa châu and marks him as hers.
npcs.wants_to_hide: She can read the old Chu script on the stele but will not explain it.

npcs.name: Hùng Nhị
npcs.wants_to_say: He is the bear spirit, son of the old bear woman lão thái and brother of Hùng Đại.

npcs.name: Ngô Á
npcs.wants_to_say: He is a vampire-line veteran and Hồng Yên quán VIP who pushes Tề Lượng's alliance along.

npcs.name: Đại Giác
npcs.wants_to_say: His evil thought wants to refine the relic in his skull and spread, possessing elders like Thanh Chính.

npcs.name: Kẻ nghiện thuốc
npcs.wants_to_say: He swaps stamps at the fairs and offers contact through his cold fire stone.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He bears a slave mark that makes him the Market's servant for life.

npcs.name: Đãng Trầm
npcs.wants_to_say: He chose his candidate before he died, so that candidate can still enter.

npcs.name: lão đầu tử
npcs.wants_to_say: He is Triệu Khách's cooking master in Lạc Đô and has searched his whole life for the woman who left him.

npcs.name: Tam Linh cô nãi nãi
npcs.wants_to_say: Villagers revere her as a living Bồ Tát; she commands her red Hồ linh as a đệ tử xuất mã.

npcs.name: Camilleri
npcs.wants_to_say: She keeps Gia Ngọc safe; that was her price for joining. She fears heights badly.

npcs.name: Thuỷ Lộc
npcs.wants_to_say: He is a self-taught yêu and former scholar who now serves Triệu Khách as steward inside the Đại Hạ đỉnh.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He calls himself a yêu quái, but even Triệu Khách cannot tell what he really is.

npcs.name: Mặc Cúc
npcs.wants_to_say: She is chief steward of Hồng Yên quán, one of its twelve stewards, favoured by Hồng bà bà.

npcs.name: Lôi Mẫu
npcs.wants_to_say: She is a personality living in Triệu Khách's body, talking to him mind-to-mind like twins.
npcs.wants_to_hide: She lives inside Triệu Khách's body as a personality built to pass through to his main mind.

npcs.name: Trù Tam Điên
npcs.wants_to_say: He is the head cook of the Bạch gia back kitchen, devoted to his paper wife Thúy Lan and their noodle shop.

npcs.name: Yuri
npcs.wants_to_say: He is the weakened Tinh Minh captain who commanded the Noah, and he needs help.
